blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Lawyers for Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa have returned to the Supreme Court, urging it to reconsider its earlier ruling and shield the senator from any attempt to arrest him and turn him over to the International Criminal Court (ICC). In a manifestation dated Oct. 27, the law firm of Atty. Israelito Torreon asked the high court to urgently resolve the motion for reconsideration it filed in June. The same manifestation also asks the high tribunal to issue a temporary restraining order against Dela Rosa’s looming arrest in connection with his crimes against humanity case before the ICC. […]...
